---
title: "Calculator: 2x2 matrix visualisation"
author: Tom Coleman, Ross Mcphee
format: html
abstract-title: Summary
abstract: A calculator to provide visualisations for what a $2\times 2$ matrix does to vectors in 2D space.
---

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
library("webexercises")
```


```{=html}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>2×2 matrix visualiser</title>

  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: #f5f6f8;
      color: #222222;
    }

    .mtv-app {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(290px, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-card {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid #dddddd;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-card-header {
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #3F6BB6;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-card-body { padding: 1rem; }

    .mtv-app .mtv-help {
      margin: 0 0 1rem;
      color: #555555;
      font-size: 0.93rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-matrix-editor {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      margin: 1rem 0 1.2rem;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-matrix-bracket {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      color: #333333;
      font-size: 7rem;
      font-weight: 1;
      line-height: 0.75;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-matrix-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 76px);
      gap: 0.65rem;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-entry-label {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-matrix-entry {
      width: 76px;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.4rem;
      border: 1px solid #cccccc;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: #ffffff;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-button-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-button {
      min-height: 42px;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem;
      border: 1px solid #31558f;
      border-radius: 5px;
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #3F6BB6;
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-button:hover { background: #31558f; }

    .mtv-app .mtv-secondary-button {
      color: #203f73;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-secondary-button:hover { background: #eef3fb; }

    .mtv-app .mtv-option {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-option input {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      margin: 0.08rem 0 0;
      accent-color: #3F68B6;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-error {
      min-height: 1.4em;
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      color: #b00020;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-equation {
      padding: 0.8rem;
      border: 1px solid #d9e2f2;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: #f4f7fc;
      color: #203f73;
      text-align: center;
      font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-plot-title {
      margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-chart-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 480px;
    }

    .mtv-app canvas {
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-legend {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-legend-item {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-line-symbol {
      width: 24px;
      height: 3px;
      background: #3F6BB6;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-red-line-symbol { background: #db4315; }

    .mtv-app .mtv-blue-area-symbol,
    .mtv-app .mtv-red-area-symbol {
      width: 22px;
      height: 13px;
      border: 1px solid #3F6BB6;
      background: rgba(63, 104, 182, 0.25);
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-red-area-symbol {
      border-color: #db4315;
      background: rgba(219, 67, 21, 0.25);
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-description {
      margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
      color: #555555;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-summary {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-summary-item {
      padding: 0.8rem;
      border: 1px solid #d9e2f2;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: #f4f7fc;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-summary-label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
      color: #555555;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-summary-value {
      color: #203f73;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .mtv-app .mtv-matrix-entry:focus-visible,
    .mtv-app .mtv-button:focus-visible,
    .mtv-app .mtv-option input:focus-visible,
    .mtv-app canvas:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(63, 104, 182, 0.4);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 800px) {
      .mtv-app .mtv-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .mtv-app .mtv-chart-wrapper { height: 420px; }
      .mtv-app .mtv-summary { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 520px) {
      body { padding: 0.5rem; }
      .mtv-app .mtv-card-body { padding: 0.9rem; }
      .mtv-app .mtv-chart-wrapper { height: 340px; }
      .mtv-app .mtv-summary { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>

<main class="mtv-app">
  <div class="mtv-row">

    <section class="mtv-card" aria-labelledby="mtv-parameters-heading">
      <div class="mtv-card-header" id="mtv-parameters-heading">Matrix A</div>

      <div class="mtv-card-body">
        <p class="mtv-help">
          Enter four numbers into the entries of the matrix A, then select Apply matrix to draw
          the images A<b>i</b> and A<b>j</b> of the unit vectors <b>i</b> and <b>j</b>.
        </p>

        <div class="mtv-matrix-editor" role="group" aria-label="Entries of matrix A">
          <span class="mtv-matrix-bracket" aria-hidden="true">[</span>

          <div class="mtv-matrix-grid">
            <div>
              <label class="mtv-entry-label" for="mtv-a11">Entry a 1 1</label>
              <input class="mtv-matrix-entry" id="mtv-a11" type="number" value="1" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="mtv-entry-label" for="mtv-a12">Entry a 1 2</label>
              <input class="mtv-matrix-entry" id="mtv-a12" type="number" value="0" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="mtv-entry-label" for="mtv-a21">Entry a 2 1</label>
              <input class="mtv-matrix-entry" id="mtv-a21" type="number" value="0" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="mtv-entry-label" for="mtv-a22">Entry a 2 2</label>
              <input class="mtv-matrix-entry" id="mtv-a22" type="number" value="1" step="0.1" inputmode="decimal">
            </div>
          </div>

          <span class="mtv-matrix-bracket" aria-hidden="true"> ] </span>
        </div>

        <div class="mtv-equation" id="mtv-matrix-display" aria-live="polite">
          A = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]
        </div>

        <label class="mtv-option">
          <input id="mtv-show-determinant" type="checkbox">
          <span>
            Visualise determinant areas: the unit square in blue and its
            transformed parallelogram in red.
          </span>
        </label>

        <div class="mtv-button-row">
          <button class="mtv-button" id="mtv-apply" type="button">Apply matrix</button>
          <button class="mtv-button mtv-secondary-button" id="mtv-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
        </div>

        <div class="mtv-error" id="mtv-error" role="alert" aria-live="assertive"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="mtv-card" aria-labelledby="mtv-plot-heading">
      <div class="mtv-card-header" id="mtv-plot-heading">Visualisation of 2D space</div>

      <div class="mtv-card-body">
        <div class="mtv-plot-title" id="mtv-plot-title">
          Standard basis vectors i and j
        </div>

        <div class="mtv-chart-wrapper">
          <canvas
            id="mtv-chart"
            tabindex="0"
            role="img"
            aria-describedby="mtv-chart-description">
          </canvas>
        </div>

        <div class="mtv-legend" aria-hidden="true">
          <span class="mtv-legend-item"><span class="mtv-line-symbol"></span><b>i</b> and <b>j</b></span>
          <span class="mtv-legend-item" id="mtv-transformed-vector-key" hidden><span class="mtv-line-symbol mtv-red-line-symbol"></span>A<b>i</b> and A<b>j</b></span>
          <span class="mtv-legend-item" id="mtv-unit-area-key" hidden><span class="mtv-blue-area-symbol"></span>Unit area</span>
          <span class="mtv-legend-item" id="mtv-transformed-area-key" hidden><span class="mtv-red-area-symbol"></span>Transformed area</span>
        </div>

        <p class="mtv-description" id="mtv-chart-description"></p>
      </div>
    </section>

  </div>

  <section class="mtv-card" aria-labelledby="mtv-summary-heading">
    <div class="mtv-card-header" id="mtv-summary-heading">Transformation summary</div>

    <div class="mtv-card-body">
      <div class="mtv-summary" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
        <div class="mtv-summary-item">
          <span class="mtv-summary-label">A<b>i</b></span>
          <span class="mtv-summary-value" id="mtv-ai-value">Not applied</span>
        </div>
        <div class="mtv-summary-item">
          <span class="mtv-summary-label">A<b>j</b></span>
          <span class="mtv-summary-value" id="mtv-aj-value">Not applied</span>
        </div>
        <div class="mtv-summary-item">
          <span class="mtv-summary-label">det(A)</span>
          <span class="mtv-summary-value" id="mtv-determinant-value">Not applied</span>
        </div>
        <div class="mtv-summary-item">
          <span class="mtv-summary-label">Area scale factor</span>
          <span class="mtv-summary-value" id="mtv-area-value">Not applied</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";

  const mtvRoot = document.querySelector(".mtv-app");
  if (!mtvRoot) return;

  const mtvA11 = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-a11");
  const mtvA12 = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-a12");
  const mtvA21 = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-a21");
  const mtvA22 = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-a22");
  const mtvApplyButton = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-apply");
  const mtvResetButton = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-reset");
  const mtvShowDeterminant = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-show-determinant");
  const mtvMatrixDisplay = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-matrix-display");
  const mtvError = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-error");
  const mtvPlotTitle = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-plot-title");
  const mtvChartDescription = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-chart-description");
  const mtvCanvas = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-chart");
  const mtvContext = mtvCanvas.getContext("2d");
  const mtvAiValue = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-ai-value");
  const mtvAjValue = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-aj-value");
  const mtvDeterminantValue = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-determinant-value");
  const mtvAreaValue = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-area-value");
  const mtvTransformedVectorKey = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-transformed-vector-key");
  const mtvUnitAreaKey = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-unit-area-key");
  const mtvTransformedAreaKey = mtvRoot.querySelector("#mtv-transformed-area-key");

  let mtvAppliedMatrix = null;

  function mtvFormatNumber(mtvValue) {
    if (Math.abs(mtvValue) < 1e-12) return "0";
    return Number(mtvValue.toFixed(3)).toString();
  }

  function mtvReadMatrix() {
    const mtvEntries = [
      Number(mtvA11.value),
      Number(mtvA12.value),
      Number(mtvA21.value),
      Number(mtvA22.value)
    ];

    if (!mtvEntries.every(Number.isFinite)) {
      mtvError.textContent = "Enter a valid numerical value in every matrix entry.";
      [mtvA11, mtvA12, mtvA21, mtvA22].forEach(function(mtvInput) {
        mtvInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", Number.isFinite(Number(mtvInput.value)) ? "false" : "true");
      });
      return null;
    }

    mtvError.textContent = "";
    [mtvA11, mtvA12, mtvA21, mtvA22].forEach(function(mtvInput) {
      mtvInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "false");
    });

    return {
      a11: mtvEntries[0],
      a12: mtvEntries[1],
      a21: mtvEntries[2],
      a22: mtvEntries[3]
    };
  }

  function mtvUpdateMatrixDisplay() {
    const mtvMatrix = mtvReadMatrix();
    if (!mtvMatrix) return;

    mtvMatrixDisplay.textContent =
      `A = [[${mtvFormatNumber(mtvMatrix.a11)}, ${mtvFormatNumber(mtvMatrix.a12)}], ` +
      `[${mtvFormatNumber(mtvMatrix.a21)}, ${mtvFormatNumber(mtvMatrix.a22)}]]`;
  }

  function mtvVectorMagnitude(mtvVector) {
    return Math.hypot(mtvVector.x, mtvVector.y);
  }

  function mtvDrawArrow(mtvStart, mtvEnd, mtvColour, mtvWidth, mtvLabel, mtvToX, mtvToY) {
    const mtvStartX = mtvToX(mtvStart.x);
    const mtvStartY = mtvToY(mtvStart.y);
    const mtvEndX = mtvToX(mtvEnd.x);
    const mtvEndY = mtvToY(mtvEnd.y);
    const mtvAngle = Math.atan2(mtvEndY - mtvStartY, mtvEndX - mtvStartX);
    const mtvHeadLength = 11;

    mtvContext.strokeStyle = mtvColour;
    mtvContext.fillStyle = mtvColour;
    mtvContext.lineWidth = mtvWidth;
    mtvContext.beginPath();
    mtvContext.moveTo(mtvStartX, mtvStartY);
    mtvContext.lineTo(mtvEndX, mtvEndY);
    mtvContext.stroke();

    if (Math.hypot(mtvEndX - mtvStartX, mtvEndY - mtvStartY) > 2) {
      mtvContext.beginPath();
      mtvContext.moveTo(mtvEndX, mtvEndY);
      mtvContext.lineTo(
        mtvEndX - mtvHeadLength * Math.cos(mtvAngle - Math.PI / 6),
        mtvEndY - mtvHeadLength * Math.sin(mtvAngle - Math.PI / 6)
      );
      mtvContext.lineTo(
        mtvEndX - mtvHeadLength * Math.cos(mtvAngle + Math.PI / 6),
        mtvEndY - mtvHeadLength * Math.sin(mtvAngle + Math.PI / 6)
      );
      mtvContext.closePath();
      mtvContext.fill();
    }

    mtvContext.font = "bold 14px Arial";
    mtvContext.textAlign = "left";
    mtvContext.textBaseline = "bottom";
    mtvContext.fillText(mtvLabel, mtvEndX + 7, mtvEndY - 5);
  }

  function mtvDrawPolygon(mtvPoints, mtvFill, mtvStroke, mtvToX, mtvToY) {
    mtvContext.beginPath();
    mtvContext.moveTo(mtvToX(mtvPoints[0].x), mtvToY(mtvPoints[0].y));

    for (let mtvIndex = 1; mtvIndex < mtvPoints.length; mtvIndex++) {
      mtvContext.lineTo(mtvToX(mtvPoints[mtvIndex].x), mtvToY(mtvPoints[mtvIndex].y));
    }

    mtvContext.closePath();
    mtvContext.fillStyle = mtvFill;
    mtvContext.fill();
    mtvContext.strokeStyle = mtvStroke;
    mtvContext.lineWidth = 1.5;
    mtvContext.stroke();
  }

  function mtvDraw() {
    const mtvRect = mtvCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!mtvRect.width || !mtvRect.height) return;

    const mtvDpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    mtvCanvas.width = Math.round(mtvRect.width * mtvDpr);
    mtvCanvas.height = Math.round(mtvRect.height * mtvDpr);
    mtvContext.setTransform(mtvDpr, 0, 0, mtvDpr, 0, 0);

    const mtvWidth = mtvRect.width;
    const mtvHeight = mtvRect.height;
    const mtvPadding = 36;
    const mtvI = { x: 1, y: 0 };
    const mtvJ = { x: 0, y: 1 };

    let mtvAi = null;
    let mtvAj = null;

    if (mtvAppliedMatrix) {
      mtvAi = { x: mtvAppliedMatrix.a11, y: mtvAppliedMatrix.a21 };
      mtvAj = { x: mtvAppliedMatrix.a12, y: mtvAppliedMatrix.a22 };
    }

    const mtvCandidateValues = [-2, 2, -1, 1];

    if (mtvAi && mtvAj) {
      [mtvAi, mtvAj, { x: mtvAi.x + mtvAj.x, y: mtvAi.y + mtvAj.y }].forEach(
        function(mtvPoint) {
          mtvCandidateValues.push(mtvPoint.x, mtvPoint.y);
        }
      );
    }

    const mtvMaximumCoordinate = Math.max(
      2,
      ...mtvCandidateValues.map(Math.abs)
    );
    const mtvLimit = Math.ceil(mtvMaximumCoordinate + 0.75);
    const mtvScale = Math.min(
      (mtvWidth - 2 * mtvPadding) / (2 * mtvLimit),
      (mtvHeight - 2 * mtvPadding) / (2 * mtvLimit)
    );
    const mtvOriginX = mtvWidth / 2;
    const mtvOriginY = mtvHeight / 2;
    const mtvToX = function(mtvValue) { return mtvOriginX + mtvValue * mtvScale; };
    const mtvToY = function(mtvValue) { return mtvOriginY - mtvValue * mtvScale; };

    mtvContext.clearRect(0, 0, mtvWidth, mtvHeight);

    for (let mtvGridValue = -mtvLimit; mtvGridValue <= mtvLimit; mtvGridValue++) {
      const mtvX = mtvToX(mtvGridValue);
      const mtvY = mtvToY(mtvGridValue);
      mtvContext.strokeStyle = mtvGridValue === 0 ? "#777777" : "#e5e5e5";
      mtvContext.lineWidth = mtvGridValue === 0 ? 1.5 : 1;

      mtvContext.beginPath();
      mtvContext.moveTo(mtvX, mtvToY(-mtvLimit));
      mtvContext.lineTo(mtvX, mtvToY(mtvLimit));
      mtvContext.stroke();

      mtvContext.beginPath();
      mtvContext.moveTo(mtvToX(-mtvLimit), mtvY);
      mtvContext.lineTo(mtvToX(mtvLimit), mtvY);
      mtvContext.stroke();
    }

    mtvContext.fillStyle = "#444444";
    mtvContext.font = "12px Arial";
    mtvContext.textAlign = "center";
    mtvContext.textBaseline = "top";

    for (let mtvTick = -mtvLimit; mtvTick <= mtvLimit; mtvTick++) {
      if (mtvTick !== 0) {
        mtvContext.fillText(String(mtvTick), mtvToX(mtvTick), mtvOriginY + 7);
        mtvContext.textAlign = "right";
        mtvContext.textBaseline = "middle";
        mtvContext.fillText(String(mtvTick), mtvOriginX - 7, mtvToY(mtvTick));
        mtvContext.textAlign = "center";
        mtvContext.textBaseline = "top";
      }
    }

    if (mtvShowDeterminant.checked) {
      mtvDrawPolygon(
        [{ x: 0, y: 0 }, mtvI, { x: 1, y: 1 }, mtvJ],
        "rgba(63, 104, 182, 0.22)",
        "#3F68B6",
        mtvToX,
        mtvToY
      );

      if (mtvAi && mtvAj) {
        mtvDrawPolygon(
          [
            { x: 0, y: 0 },
            mtvAi,
            { x: mtvAi.x + mtvAj.x, y: mtvAi.y + mtvAj.y },
            mtvAj
          ],
          "rgba(219, 67, 21, 0.25)",
          "#db4315",
          mtvToX,
          mtvToY
        );
      }
    }

    mtvDrawArrow({ x: 0, y: 0 }, mtvI, "#3F68B6", 3, "i", mtvToX, mtvToY);
    mtvDrawArrow({ x: 0, y: 0 }, mtvJ, "#3F68B6", 3, "j", mtvToX, mtvToY);

    if (mtvAi && mtvAj) {
      mtvDrawArrow({ x: 0, y: 0 }, mtvAi, "#db4315", 3, "Ai", mtvToX, mtvToY);
      mtvDrawArrow({ x: 0, y: 0 }, mtvAj, "#9b2f11", 3, "Aj", mtvToX, mtvToY);
    }

    mtvContext.fillStyle = "#333333";
    mtvContext.font = "13px Arial";
    mtvContext.textAlign = "right";
    mtvContext.textBaseline = "bottom";
    mtvContext.fillText("x", mtvToX(mtvLimit) - 4, mtvOriginY - 8);
    mtvContext.textAlign = "left";
    mtvContext.fillText("y", mtvOriginX + 8, mtvToY(mtvLimit) + 16);

    let mtvDescription =
      "Cartesian plane showing the standard basis vectors i equals [1, 0]^T and j equals [0, 1]^T.";

    if (mtvAi && mtvAj) {
      const mtvDeterminant =
        mtvAppliedMatrix.a11 * mtvAppliedMatrix.a22 -
        mtvAppliedMatrix.a12 * mtvAppliedMatrix.a21;

      mtvDescription +=
        ` The applied matrix sends i to [${mtvFormatNumber(mtvAi.x)}, ` +
        `${mtvFormatNumber(mtvAi.y)}]^T and j to ` +
        `[${mtvFormatNumber(mtvAj.x)}, ${mtvFormatNumber(mtvAj.y)}]^T. ` +
        `The determinant is ${mtvFormatNumber(mtvDeterminant)}, so areas are ` +
        `scaled by ${mtvFormatNumber(Math.abs(mtvDeterminant))}.`;
    }

    if (mtvShowDeterminant.checked) {
      mtvDescription += mtvAppliedMatrix
        ? " The blue unit square and red transformed parallelogram are shown."
        : " The blue unit square is shown; apply the matrix to show its transformed area.";
    }

    mtvCanvas.setAttribute("aria-label", mtvDescription);
    mtvChartDescription.textContent = mtvDescription;
  }

  function mtvApply() {
    const mtvMatrix = mtvReadMatrix();
    if (!mtvMatrix) return;

    mtvAppliedMatrix = mtvMatrix;

    const mtvAi = { x: mtvMatrix.a11, y: mtvMatrix.a21 };
    const mtvAj = { x: mtvMatrix.a12, y: mtvMatrix.a22 };
    const mtvDeterminant =
      mtvMatrix.a11 * mtvMatrix.a22 -
      mtvMatrix.a12 * mtvMatrix.a21;

    mtvAiValue.textContent =
      `(${mtvFormatNumber(mtvAi.x)}, ${mtvFormatNumber(mtvAi.y)})`;
    mtvAjValue.textContent =
      `(${mtvFormatNumber(mtvAj.x)}, ${mtvFormatNumber(mtvAj.y)})`;
    mtvDeterminantValue.textContent = mtvFormatNumber(mtvDeterminant);
    mtvAreaValue.textContent = mtvFormatNumber(Math.abs(mtvDeterminant));

    mtvPlotTitle.textContent = "Standard basis and transformed basis vectors";
    mtvTransformedVectorKey.hidden = false;
    mtvUnitAreaKey.hidden = !mtvShowDeterminant.checked;
    mtvTransformedAreaKey.hidden = !mtvShowDeterminant.checked;

    mtvUpdateMatrixDisplay();
    mtvDraw();
  }

  function mtvReset() {
    mtvA11.value = 1;
    mtvA12.value = 0;
    mtvA21.value = 0;
    mtvA22.value = 1;
    mtvShowDeterminant.checked = false;
    mtvAppliedMatrix = null;
    mtvError.textContent = "";
    mtvAiValue.textContent = "Not applied";
    mtvAjValue.textContent = "Not applied";
    mtvDeterminantValue.textContent = "Not applied";
    mtvAreaValue.textContent = "Not applied";
    mtvPlotTitle.textContent = "Standard basis vectors i and j";
    mtvTransformedVectorKey.hidden = true;
    mtvUnitAreaKey.hidden = true;
    mtvTransformedAreaKey.hidden = true;
    mtvUpdateMatrixDisplay();
    mtvDraw();
    mtvA11.focus();
  }

  [mtvA11, mtvA12, mtvA21, mtvA22].forEach(function(mtvInput) {
    mtvInput.addEventListener("input", mtvUpdateMatrixDisplay);
  });

  mtvApplyButton.addEventListener("click", mtvApply);
  mtvResetButton.addEventListener("click", mtvReset);

  mtvShowDeterminant.addEventListener("change", function() {
    mtvUnitAreaKey.hidden = !mtvShowDeterminant.checked;
    mtvTransformedAreaKey.hidden =
      !mtvShowDeterminant.checked || !mtvAppliedMatrix;
    mtvDraw();
  });

  let mtvResizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    window.clearTimeout(mtvResizeTimer);
    mtvResizeTimer = window.setTimeout(mtvDraw, 80);
  });

  mtvUpdateMatrixDisplay();
  mtvDraw();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
```
